newsitem.title: UK: Norwich says new life, pensions business up.
newsitem.headline: Norwich says new life, pensions business up.

text.p: British insurance group Norwich Union said on Wednesday its world-wide new single premium life and investment business rose 19 percent to 836 million stg in the first half of 1997.
The group said its world-wide new regular premium business was down two percent to 93 million stg.

Norwich's annual premium equivalent growth was 17 percent in the UK with new life and pensions single premium business rising 20 percent to 507 million stg. Regular premium business rose 10 percent to 54 million stg.
Sales of Norwich Union's with-profit bonds stood at 129 million stg, it said.
